positions.title: Python Track Maintainer (volunteer)
positions.description:
Mentoring students in Python coding.  Maintainer of the Python, Julia, and R tracks.  Org-wide moderator and code guardian.

Track planning, tooling (test runners, analyzers, and representers), and content (concepts, exercises, and tests).  Reviewer of contributions and mentor to aspiring maintainers. Authored or co-authored 15+ exercises and contributed code or tests to over 50 more.

positions.title: Python Track Mentor (volunteer)
positions.description: Successfully mentored 500+ students and 641+ solutions with a 100% satisfaction rating and 41 testimonials. Contributed small bug fixes and test changes to track GitHub repo.

positions.title: Engineer & Mentor
positions.description: Planned and developed a LMS (learning management system) prototype and curriculum for a proposed Machine Learning & AI bootcamp, and mentored junior software engineers on the team. Created Docker images of the Python “Scientific Stack” (Anaconda, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Pandas) for student download and use in workshops and trainings. Conducted “setup workshops” for Python ML/AI environments and provided assistance and mentoring at Accel.ai sponsored ML/AI trainings and hackathons, with up to 300 attendees.

projects.title: NANA (Not Another Nutrition App)
projects.description:
An individual  4-week project after initial instruction in programming and web frameworks.  NANA utilizes a modified Nutritionix JQuery plugin, data from the USDA DB for standard nutritional reference, Python NLTK &  Pattern, Beautiful Soup, Flask, Postgresql trgm, and Postgresql  fuzzystrmatch.  

Select a recipe URL from a supported website, press analyze, and get a nutritional estimate back.   Simple.

projects.title: ChiCa App - Mothers Connected, Children Protected
projects.description:
Enabling mothers in developing countries to create trusted childcare networks.

Built as a 4-person team using Python, Flask, and the Twilio API at CHIMEHACK2 -- a two-day hackathon for women's safety at Twitter HQ.

"Team ChiCa, a crowd favorite, makes it easier for women to find free or affordable childcare in their area by calling a voice-activated messaging system. Winners of the Uber Prize for Scalability & Global Impact"
-Elle.com
